landing_location.basis: PLAN_FINAL_R3_DELTA.md D-12 landing-coordinate input; the NASA/LROC observed fix and ISRO planned target are recorded separately.

observation_geometry.basis: R3 D-3 and D-8 smooth-sphere geometry lock.
observation_geometry.observer: spherical lunar surface site at 0 m height
observation_geometry.topocentric_direction: LT+S apparent Moon-centred Sun vector minus site vector

reference_frame.basis: R3 D-3 locked MOON_ME_DE421 frame; ephemeris sidecar requires this frame.

sun_elevation_definition.basis: Ephemeris.body_at subtracts the site vector from the interpolated Sun-centre vector before site-frame elevation conversion.
sun_elevation_definition.calculated_value: Sun-centre apparent topocentric elevation above the local spherical horizontal

touchdown_time.basis: PLAN_FINAL_R3_DELTA.md D-12; no primary seconds-level source located.

im2_touchdown_conditions.limitation: The catalog records the documented IM-2 touchdown timestamp and landing coordinates, but this report has no independent primary source for a touchdown Sun or Earth condition.

qualitative_timeline_check.criterion: The Sun drops below the project director's 6-degree operations minimum inside the 2-4 Sep 2023 sleep window (TOI 2023-09-02: sleep planned for Sunday 3 Sep, begun before 6 degrees; ISRO 4 Sep: lander and rover in sleep mode).

reference.source: Times of India, 2023-09-02: Chandrayaan-3 project director P Veeramuthuvel (see source_metadata)

source_metadata.document_title: Chandrayaan-3: Mission goals met, Vikram, Pragyan to be put to sleep Sunday
open_caveats: limb convention (Sun centre vs limb) not stated by the source
no uncertainty stated by the source; the +/-0.25 deg tolerance is the plan's
press interview with the project director, not an ISRO technical document
source_metadata.page_or_section: Quote of Chandrayaan-3 project director P Veeramuthuvel (exclusive interaction with TOI)
source_metadata.quoted_numerical_claim: For landing, the angle requirement was 6-9° elevation and we managed to land when elevation was 8.75°.
source_metadata.quoted_operations_claim: For operations, we need a minimum of 6° elevation angle because our cameras and other systems are characterised for that.
source_metadata.quoted_sleep_plan: Isro is opting to begin the process of enabling sleep mode earlier than that.
source_metadata.research_note: Located after the R3 source review: the project director's statement to the Times of India gives both the 8.75 degree landing Sun elevation and the 6 degree operations minimum. ISRO's own mission page states no landing time or angle.

sources_examined.publication_date: not stated; dated mission updates span 2023-07-06 to 2023-09-22
sources_examined.quoted_claim: Chandrayaan-3 has successfully soft-landed on the moon.
